title: Perceptual Spatial Reification & Correspondence Runtime
objective: Add a bounded perceptual-spatial reification and correspondence runtime over sealed MSLR observations/projections so authorized participants can experience non-standard spatial laws through stable semantic-to-perceptual cue bindings without turning presentation, client observation or inferred perception into canonical spatial truth.
acceptance: Reification binds accepted MSLR law/projection/observation references to perceptual cue sets with exact source/owner versions and stable canonical identity.
Semantic source kinds include location, route, frame, layer, boundary, transition and contradiction while presentation coordinates remain noncanonical.
Correspondence supports exact, ambiguous, partial, contradictory and unknown perceptual relations without fabricating hidden topology.
True/observable/known/suspected states remain distinct and reification never promotes observation/hypothesis to canonical truth.
Observer/permission filtering occurs before cue counts, correspondence search, diagnostics, explanation, AI context and export.
Hidden routes/predicates/solution topology cannot leak through cue counts, correspondence shape, confidence, omission metadata or alternate modalities.
Equivalent semantic/text, visual, audio and other available presentation bindings preserve meaning; no blocking cue depends on a single sensory channel.
Local orientation/frame transforms and canonical identity remain stable across perceptual/presentation variants.
Round-trip perceptual evidence creates typed observation proposals only; it grants no traversal, Knowledge or spatial mutation authority.
Runtime is deterministic where inputs are deterministic, provider-off locally, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: The completed MSLR-01..18 family remains sealed; the supplement adds perceptual reification/correspondence capability without mutating prior schemas.
Visibility/Knowledge/Perception owners retain observer knowledge, memory, visibility and evidence authority.
MCS/presentation owners retain drawing/rendering/audio/haptic/text presentation authority; perceptual reification does not make presentation coordinates canonical.
World/Reality/Scene/Location and Transition/Portal/Access retain canonical identity, state and traversal authority.
Perceptual correspondence may encode ambiguity, contradiction, false/suspected observations or authored deception without rewriting true topology.
Permission filtering occurs before perceptual cue sets, counts, explanations, diagnostics, AI context or export.
Every blocking spatial cue has semantic/textual and keyboard-equivalent access; no visual/audio/color/motion-only requirement.
Provider-off operation and optional-AI independence remain blocking requirements.
SAA remains owner-held until MSLR-S02 closeout and a later explicit owner Continue.
next_action: Establish causal RED, then implement only the bounded perceptual reification/correspondence seam. MSLR-S02 and SAA remain unauthorized.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner explicitly inserted and governed-started MSLR-S01 before the held SAA boundary.
